title: claude-broker shared-notes envelope
description: Durable, addressable team knowledge that outlives any one session: a worker's finding about code outside its ownership, or an orchestrator's decision and its reason. Intended channel: <ns>-notes (prune-exempt). Read with projection='summary' at cold start; open a note in full only when its scope overlaps the files you are about to touch. Resolve a note with type:resolved when it no longer applies. Also accepts type:judgment, the judge worker's answer record, with namespace-generic question_ref and basis patterns (cb uses the stricter schemas/cb-notes.json; docs/protocol-v3.md "Judge worker").

from.description: Worker or orchestrator that posted it.

to.description: Worker it concerns, or '*' for the whole team.

subject.description: Headline, readable in the summary projection.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the claim (finding) or the choice and its reason (decision).

scope.description: Files, directories or subsystems the note is about, e.g. ['server.js', 'schemas/']. Workers match this against their files.write.

evidence.description: How it was established: a command and its output tail, a commit sha, a message id.

task_id.description: Task during which the note was made, if any.

expires_at.description: Ignore the note after this instant (e.g. a workaround with a known end date).

ref_id.description: Message id of the finding/decision this closes.

task_id.description: Task of the question being judged.

verdict.description: decided = answered from a recorded decision (basis required); returned = sent back to the asker; held = left for the human.

question_ref.description: The question message judged, e.g. mg-status#185900.

basis.description: The recorded decision relied on. Required when verdict=decided.
